Route11_EastEntrance_1F_Text_ManInLavend:
Don't you think it's hard to think up good names for POKéMON?
Especially if you've caught a whole bunch?
In LAVENDER TOWN, there's a man who rates POKéMON nicknames.
He can even help you rename your POKéMON, too.
Route11_EastEntrance_1F_Text_RockTunnelT:
If you're aiming to reach LAVENDER TOWN, take ROCK TUNNEL.
You can get to ROCK TUNNEL from CERULEAN CITY.
